description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring - Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.
Own Category Growth, Optimize Performance, and Expand Market Dominance.
Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Category Growth Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar product category, with Amazon as the primary growth channel. This is a high-impact role for a results-driven e-commerce operator who thrives on ownership, accountability, and driving measurable growth through disciplined execution and data-backed decision-making.
While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have driven growth across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to apply that experience within a scaled Amazon ecosystem.
How You’ll Win at Hadley Designs

We believe performance comes from strong systems executed consistently.
Every Category Growth Manager is expected to progress through three stages:

• Learn the Playbook - Understand our category strategy, operating standards, and decision frameworks

• Apply the Playbook - Execute accurately and consistently to deliver predictable, scalable results

• Enhance the Playbook - Improve systems with new ideas and strategies after mastery is demonstrated

This order matters. We value innovation, but only when it is grounded in proven execution. Our playbook exists to help high performers win faster, create leverage, and scale impact - not slow them down.
What You’ll Own

• End-to-end ownership of category performance, including revenue, margin, pricing, advertising, and inventory

• Ongoing optimization of product positioning, content, pricing, and promotional strategy

• Identification and validation of new product and expansion opportunities

• Lifecycle management of existing products to ensure continued relevance and profitability

• Inventory and demand planning to support growth while managing cost and risk

• Cross-functional collaboration with Product Operations, Supply Chain, and Design teams

What Success Looks Like
Within your first 90 days, you will:

• Learn and execute against Hadley Designs ’ category playbook with accuracy and consistency

• Implement performance improvements within existing strategies

• Bring forward thoughtful, data-backed ideas to improve or expand the category

• Take clear ownership of outcomes, consistently raise the performance bar, and be measured on the results you deliver

Apply Now, Own Amazon, and Shape Our Future.
Requirements
Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience owning product or category growth in e-commerce or marketplaces

• Proven ability to scale revenue and profitability, either as a brand owner or within a growth team

• Strong analytical instincts and comfort making decisions from performance data

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or the ability to quickly master platform-specific tools

• Comfortable operating within defined systems before pushing for change

• Motivated by clear goals, performance benchmarks, and winning as part of a high-performing team

• Collaborative, accountable, and driven by continuous improvement

Benefits

• Own a multi-million dollar Amazon category with a team that’s got the tools and trust to help you scale.

• Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins.

• Cash, tools, and freedom, no leash, just trust.

• Remote Full Time Work

• Flexible Schedule

• Established Company doing business for 10+ years

• Autonomy of time and schedule

• Established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard.

Apply Now
If you’re a hungry, growth-oriented e-commerce operator who values disciplined execution, clear ownership, and improving systems over time, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager, ChatGPT Space
description:
About the Team

The ChatGPT Space team is rethinking what work looks like when teams and agents can create together. We are building a shared workspace where a rough idea can become a polished, editable artifact, from Pages, Sheets, and Slides to entirely new kinds of work products.

Our ambition is to build the best place for teams and agents to turn ideas into things they could not make alone. The work should keep evolving after the first draft, drawing on shared context, improving through collaboration, and staying current as a project moves forward.

This is a high-agency team working across product, design, and research. We partner closely with model training teams to shape how frontier models create and edit artifacts, then bring those capabilities into a coherent experience across Pages, files, and tools. The work spans full-stack product engineering, editing and rendering systems, model integration, and collaboration, with a high bar for taste, correctness, and speed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Engineering Manager, ChatGPT Space, you will lead and grow the product engineering team defining this experience. You will help shape both the product and the team that builds it, turning an ambitious, evolving vision into software people love to use.

You will partner with product and design on what great collaboration between teams and agents should feel like, with research on what models can create, and with infrastructure and enterprise partners on a dependable experience at scale.

This is a role for a leader who has built from zero to one and wants to help define a new category of work. You will bring the technical depth to guide hard decisions and the product judgment to know what is worth building, while developing engineers and giving them the clarity and autonomy to ship.

This role is based in San Francisco.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Lead, manage, and grow a product engineering team, creating clear ownership, supporting engineers’ development, and hiring exceptional people

- Partner with product and design to shape the ChatGPT Space roadmap and translate user needs into focused, well-crafted releases

- Lead the development of creation, editing, and collaboration experiences for teams and agents, including tools that connect project context and keep work up to date

- Set technical direction for full-stack product systems, editing and rendering surfaces, and model-facing integrations

- Partner closely with research teams on artifact tools, model behavior, training needs, and evaluations, turning improvements in model capability into better products

- Establish a high bar for editor quality, correctness, latency, and reliability, and use user feedback and evaluation results to guide improvements

- Work with infrastructure and enterprise partners to deliver dependable experiences, align interfaces and ownership, and resolve problems across team boundaries

- Balance new product development with the technical investments and operational discipline needed to sustain quality as the product grows

- Build an effective operating cadence that keeps a fast-moving team aligned and gives engineers the context and autonomy to do their best work

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have a track record of leading engineering teams and helping engineers grow while delivering excellent products

- Have built products from zero to one and can turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear direction and practical execution plan

- Bring strong product judgment and design taste, with a deep interest in how teams and agents create, edit, and collaborate

- Have strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and can guide technical decisions across frontend, backend, and model-facing systems

- Work effectively with product, design, research, and infrastructure partners, building alignment without losing momentum

- Care deeply about craft, performance, correctness, and reliability, and can help a team improve all four while moving quickly

title: Writer (Volunteer- Unpaid)
description:
Position: Writer
Hours: minimum 4 hours per week
Location: Remote
Volunteering commitment: 3 - 6 months
Job description
We are looking for motivated, creative, and autonomous writers to join us on the Marketing, Fundraising and Operations team at ConnectionHub . You will need to be independent minded and work well in a team. This is an exciting opportunity to join our charity and help build ConnectionHub ’s online presence and increase engagement. You should be ambitious and excited by the prospect of telling our story, and eager to share ideas about the best ways in which to do this. The 4 roles available are: Feature Writer, Blogger, Social Media Content Creator and Campaign Copywriter.
Responsibilities:

• Planning, writing and publishing engaging and considerate regular content for our blog, social media, campaigns and features.

• Perform research for blog posts, articles, guides and other content.

• Work with the team to analyze content performance metrics, to improve existing content and develop better content ideas for the future.

• Conduct simple keyword research and use SEO guidelines to increase web traffic.

• Pitch articles to third-party websites for publication and guest post on partner websites.

• Work to outline expectations and requirements established in the project brief.

• Ensure all-around consistency (style, fonts, images and tone).

• Bachelor's degree in English, Creative Writing, Journalism or related field.

• Proven work experience as a writer in writing for charity, non profit or related experience.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills.

• Ability to research and learn about a wide range of topics.

• Excellent written skills and ability to communicate effectively with others.

• Ability to work to tight deadlines, while maintaining attention to detail.

• Able to commit to a weekly Zoom meeting.

• Excellent IT skills (proficient in Microsoft packages) and design packages (desirable).

Introduction to ConnectionHub

ConnectionHub is a UK-registered charity offering blended learning programmes to refugees and asylum seekers in Lesbos, Greece. Currently, the lack of educational opportunities leaves refugees and asylum seekers in Lesbos, Greece exposed to a future of social exclusion, precarious employment, exploitation, and poverty.
ConnectionHub ’s mission is to provide education and integration opportunities via blended learning pathways to people in crisis and conflict contexts, in order to reduce this human suffering and exploitation. Blended learning, which utilises both online and offline educational material and support, is proven to better facilitate student’s learning journey; with this approach we hope to give refugees and asylum seekers the chance to develop new skills that will build their capacities as individuals, help them bridge the literacy gap, and support them to change the trajectory of their lives by creating job opportunities and economic empowerment. ConnectionHub ’s programmes are accessible to displaced people regardless of legal status, gender, age, or ethnic identity.

title: Data Architect - Senior JP952
description:
Project Name:
JIMS 3.0 (Justice Information Management System)
Scope:
Justice Information Management System (JIMS) 3.0 is a data integration project aimed to amalgamate, re-design and implement several disjointed reporting data marts containing court data into an Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and a set of dependent data mart and views. This project will replace the existing six stand-alone IBM Cognos BI data marts JIMS, Crown File Ownership (CFO), Court Case Management (CCM), Courtroom Utilization, Courtroom Activity, and Case Adjournment) with a well-integrated data warehouse. The existing data marts extract, process, re-structure and aggregate data required for strategic, operational and ad hoc reporting of court data stored in the Justice Online Information Network (JOIN) database. The goal of the project is to evolve availability, governance and reporting of court data by implementing a more efficient, user-friendly, faster and cost-effective reporting architecture. Integrated and dynamic architecture
Interactive reporting
Reporting lag
Preservation of historical data
Improved data governance

This Senior Data Architect role will:
review existing data marts,
perform detailed data profiling,
analyze and create design and mapping specifications,
identify Dimensions required for Facts,
complete detailed data profiling of tables included in Facts,
develop and test Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes,
develop Power BI reports for testing for several Dimensions,
testing of Dimensions and Fact for quality assurance
update JOIN as-is data models for new Fact attributes,
stage the required data
address minor fixes in delivered data marts,
provide feedback and lessons learned at project close out.

Duties:
Facilitate the effective definition and management of the data architecture (e.g. principles, strategies, architectures, methods, design principles, models, standards, guidelines, plans, etc.);
Encourage data models and practices that reduce data redundancy by promoting reuse/sharing (in keeping with the IMT strategy);
Identify and document enterprise data requirements;
Encourage practices that improve data quality;
Develop and lead the transition plans that will guide current data to its ideal future state;
Lead or assist in communication activities surrounding the Sectors and Government of Alberta Enterprise Architecture (GAEA) data architecture;
Contribute to the definition and development of the enterprise architecture framework, and associated corporate solution design and delivery methods, thus improving the proactive alignment of data architecture;
Respond to requests for extensions to the scope of the data architecture;
Provide information, advice, guidance, and consultancy to initiatives/projects that are defining or aligning to the data architecture - thus promoting compliance to the data architecture and IMT strategies;

Provide support to other members of the enterprise architecture team as required

title: Vice President, Customer Experience
description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com http://www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced post-sales leader to unify our customer operations across three leading brands: Peek Pro, Connect&GO, and ACME Ticketing. Less than a year post-acquisition by Peek, this is a transformation mandate.

You'll own the entire post-sales operating model (Onboarding, Customer Success, Technical Support), taking the best practices from each brand to design a new, unified, world-class customer experience org. This means architecting new organizational structures, defining role clarity and accountability, and establishing the new processes and metrics that will scale intelligently. AI and automation will be your core operating system, enabling your teams to deliver exceptional service while helping clients navigate the AI era themselves.

Your mandate includes retention, expansion, and upsell. You'll shape how we operate with every client account, define what we measure and why, and align Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering around ideal customer outcomes. Expected outcomes of you: revenue growth, churn reduction, improved cost-to-serve, and elevated quality across all three teams.

Scope of Role

This VP will lead three distinct functions, unified under one CX operating model:

- Onboarding & Implementation: End-to-end client onboarding from contract close through go-live. Refine our segmented approach that delivers high-touch, white-glove onboarding for enterprise clients while deploying scalable, automation-enabled processes and one-to-many resources for smaller clients. Reduce time-to-first-value and cost-per-onboarding without sacrificing satisfaction.

- Customer Success: Oversight of retention, NDR, and lifetime value optimization. Instrument the function with data and AI to proactively identify churn risk and expansion signals in real time, freeing your team to focus on high-impact conversations. Position expansion, cross-sell, and upsell as a primary driver of revenue growth alongside retention.

- Technical Support: Ticket resolution, escalations, knowledge management, and SLA compliance. Re-think key metrics and efficiency targets, re-architect workflows to leverage automation, cross-train teams to operate effectively across geographies and time zones, and systematically surface themes, risks, and insights that inform product and success strategy.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Org Design

- Lead a multi-brand team of Directors, Managers, and ICs; develop talent and build bench strength across the unified organization

- Foster a culture of operational rigor, data-driven decision-making, and leverage so the team can focus on high-impact work rather than low-value toil

- Hire and mentor senior operators who understand both team leadership and how to amplify their impact with AI and modern tools

- Partner with existing functional leadership to ensure customer relationships remain strong and institutional knowledge is preserved during the post-M&A transition

Unification & Operational Design

- Assess the operating model across all three functions and three brands, identifying what works best in each and prioritizing unification opportunities

title: Prozessmanager:in (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie - von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One http://Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

metrify ist die Smart-Metering-Unit von Enpal und die digitale Infrastruktur für ein intelligentes Energie-Ökosystem. Mit zehntausenden installierten iMSys und skalierbaren Prozessen machen wir Energie messbar, steuerbar und wirtschaftlich nutzbar - und schaffen gemeinsam mit Partnern die Basis für neue Geschäftsmodelle der Energiewende.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du betreust operative Vorgänge rund um den Smart‑Meter‑Wechsel und hältst alle dafür notwendigen Informationen in unseren Systemen aktuell.

- Du arbeitest täglich in mehreren Systemen gleichzeitig, erkennst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Auftrag im System sauber durchläuft und korrekt abgeschlossen wird.

- Du kommunizierst klar und professionell mit Netzbetreibern, Marktpartnern & internen Teams (E-Mail, Telefon, Portale, Tickets).

- Du denkst in Regeln und Mustern: du erkennst Prozessfehler, findest Ursachen und schlägst Verbesserungen vor.Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Tasks den Überblick und kannst diese priorisieren.

- Du stellst sicher, dass regulatorische Anforderungen & interne Standards eingehalten werden.

 

DEIN PROFIL

- Du hast eine hohe Affinität zu digitalen Systemen und arbeitest gerne mit mehreren Tools und Oberflächen parallel.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und präzise - du magst es, wenn Daten sauber sind und Prozesse logisch laufen.

- Du erkennst Muster, arbeitest gerne mit Regeln/Checklisten und fühlst dich in systematischen Abläufen wohl.

- Du priorisierst gut, kannst viele parallele Vorgänge ruhig sortieren und verlierst nicht den Überblick.Du bist selbstorganisiert, lösungsorientiert und arbeistest selbstständig.

- Du kommunizierst klar - intern wie extern - und fragst früh nach, wenn Informationen fehlen.Du hast Lust, dich in ein komplexes, spannendes Arbeitsfeld (Energiewirtschaft / Marktprozesse) einzuarbeiten.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

 

DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN

- Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

- Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

- Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

- Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

- Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

- Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a AI Engineer Intern to join us this summer and help build the next generation of AI-powered data tooling at Hex.

Our mission is to empower users to understand and work with data using natural language and agentic AI capabilities. As an intern, you’ll contribute directly to product and research that sits at the core of how data teams explore, analyze, and collaborate. While prior AI research experience is desired, we’re also looking for curiosity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to dive into fast-evolving technology.

This is an opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, ship real features to production, and contribute meaningfully to one of the most exciting technical spaces of our time.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As an AI Engineer Intern, you will work across the entire research process, identifying problems, designing experiments, evaluating results, and implementing in production. Throughout this process, you will partner closely with other AI Engineers, software engineers, PMs, internal partners, and customers.

- Build run real research experiments to solve business problems, making use of modern and classical AI/ML techniques, tackling problems such as post-training, continuous learning, and agent self-improvement

- Collaborate with product engineers to deliver new AI-powered capabilities to end users

- Contribute to research infrastructure including evals, production monitoring, training pipelines, and more

- Solve practical engineering challenges, such as performance optimizations, data modeling, and API design

- Participate in the full development lifecycle, from ideation and design to implementation, testing, and launch.

ABOUT YOU

- You are pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with plans to graduate in December 2027 or sometime in 2028

- You have AI research, applied AI, or ML experience, ideally having worked on substantive generative AI or transformer-based projects

- You have an interest in how you can build delightful product experiences backed by cutting edge technology, and an appetite for pushing the boundaries of what agents can accomplish

- You care about users and enjoy thinking about how technical systems translate into polished, intuitive experiences.

- You are curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as new technology emerges.

- You enjoy collaborating with others, asking questions, and learning from more senior engineers.

The compensation for this role is $11,000 a month + a housing stipend.

In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Eingangsrechnungen und Zahlungsverkehr. Du betreust unseren Rechnungsworkflow von A bis Z: Rechnungseingang, fehlende Belege, Freigaben und Zahlungen. Du überwachst den Zahlungsverkehr der Gruppe und führst einen Großteil der freigegebenen Zahlungen selbst in Agicap aus.

title: Penetration Tester
description:
About the Role
The Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities across external networks, web applications, and APIs. In this role, you will be responsible for the execution of penetration testing engagements, including identifying, validating, and manually exploiting vulnerabilities, evaluating potential attack paths, and documenting findings and remediation guidance. As the Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and creative strategies to support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Penetration Tester to support management, independently execute assigned projects, communicate technical findings to clients, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our offensive security tools, methodologies, and delivery processes.
Reports to
Director, Web Application & External Offensive Operations
Pay Classification
Full-Time, Exempt
Responsibilities

• Execute external network, web application, and API penetration testing engagements in accordance with defined scopes, methodologies, and rules of engagement

• Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, internally developed techniques, or a combination of approaches

• Evaluate attack paths and determine the potential business and technical impact of identified vulnerabilities

• Compile and write clear, accurate, and defensible client reports that explain findings, risk, evidence, and remediation guidance

• Communicate with clients throughout engagements, including technical discussions, findings walkthroughs, and responses to questions or challenges

• Execute assigned projects with minimal oversight while maintaining quality, professionalism, and attention to detail

• Collaborate with team members to evaluate offensive security tools and improve testing methodologies, delivery processes, and reporting standards

• Share technical knowledge and practical guidance with less-experienced team members and clients when appropriate

• Maintain current knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security research, and industry trends

Minimum Qualifications
EDUCATION

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, management information systems, computer science, or relevant discipline
EXPERIENCE

• 2-5 years of hands-on penetration testing experience in at least one of the following areas:

• External Penetration Tests

• Web Application Penetration Tests

• API Penetration Tests

• Mobile Application Penetration Tests

• Experience independently executing penetration testing engagements and producing high-quality client deliverables

• Knowledge of established penetration testing methodologies and disciplined evidence collection practices

• Experience identifying and manually validating exploitable vulnerabilities rather than relying solely on automated scanning

• Experience communicating technical findings, risk, and remediation guidance clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

CERTIFICATIONS

• Preferred OSCP, eWPT, eWPTX, OSWA, or OSWE certification
SKILLS

• Proficiency with commonly used offensive security tools such as Nmap, SQLmap, Burp Suite, Postman, Nuclei, Wireshark, Nessus, and Caido

• Proficiency with one or more scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or SQL

• Solid understanding of web technologies, networking concepts, authentication, access control, and common application security weaknesses

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a remote, fast-paced environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to different audiences

• Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a high degree of motivation, self-discipline, and quality

Benefits

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance

• EAP - Employee Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance

• 401(k) Plan with Employer

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX Brazil is building its finance function from the ground up while preparing for supervision by the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) under the new virtual asset service provider (SPSAV/PSAV) framework. We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Analyst to join our Brazil team and take ownership of core day-to-day accounting, accounts payable, and tax-compliance operations.

You will work alongside the Senior Finance Manager and the Finance & Accounting Specialist, in a role where accuracy, documentation, and discipline matter. Our books will soon be reviewed by a regulator, not only by auditors. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to financial regulation, crypto, and Brazil’s tax reform.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Accounting & Month-End Close

•
Prepare monthly close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and recurring accounting schedules.

•
Prepare and review intercompany journal entries and reconcile intercompany balances with affiliates to ensure accuracy and consistency.

•
Maintain close checklists and supporting documentation in FloQast and NetSuite, meeting group reporting deadlines.

•
Support the local Portuguese-language books, helping keep entries aligned with Brazilian GAAP and the BCB chart of accounts (COSIF) as we prepare for regulated status.

•
Accounts Payable & Expense Management

•
Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and weekly payment batches in line with internal policies and approval matrices.

•
Validate vendor documentation and apply the correct tax treatment before payment.

•
Review withholding taxes on vendor payments (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS), and keep payment files and supporting documents audit-ready.

•
Tax Compliance Support

•
Issue electronic invoices for company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with municipal and federal requirements.

•
Support the monthly review of VAT and CIT calculations and maintain supporting documentation.

•
Support tax-to-accounting reconciliations and coordinate with our outsourced accounting firm on filings and information requests.

•
Help us follow and prepare for the Brazilian tax reform (IBS/CBS) transition, including the impact on invoicing, vendor payments, and ERP configuration.

•
Audit & Controls

•
Support external audit and group-level audit requests: prepare PBC lists, schedules, and reconciliations.

•
Follow documented controls and flag exceptions or gaps. Contribute to SOPs and process improvements as we build a controlled environment suited to a regulated entity.

What We’re Looking For

•
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CRC registration is a plus).

•
3+ years of experience in accounting, preferably in financial services, fintech, crypto, or big 4.

•
Solid knowledge of IFRS and BR GAAP/CPC. Familiarity with tax is a plus.

•
Hands-on experience with month-end closing, reconciliations, and AP processes.

•
Strong attention to detail, a sense of ownership, and the discipline to document your work.

•
Intermediate-to-advance

title: Une Ingénieure ou un Ingénieur : procédés et formation en salle blanche microélectronique - Centre Microélectronique de Provence – CDD 2 ans
description:
L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le premier groupe public français de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management. Il fédère huit écoles publiques, deux écoles filiales et un vaste réseau de partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels.
Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique.
Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires.
Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues.
Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous
Dans le cadre du projet I-novmicro porté par le Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur, des modules de formation aux procédés de fabrication en microélectronique sont proposés à des étudiants et apprenants en formation initiale ou continue. La formation se concentrera sur la réalisation de transistor NMOS.
Le Centre de Microélectronique de Provence recrute un ingénieur pour mettre en place et dispenser ces formations, gérer les opérations nécessaires au bon déroulement de celles-ci.

Vos Missions :
Achat d’équipements
La personne retenue gérera, dans un premier temps, l’achat de nouveaux équipements destinés aux formations décrites en introduction.
Mise en place de la formation
La personne sera chargée de développer le module de formation sur le transistor NMOS, en ciblant certains procédés de fabrication. Elle assurera ensuite l’animation des sessions de formation aux procédés microélectroniques associées à ce module.
Ainsi, la personne recrutée devra être former aux procédés standard utilisés en microélectronique (front-end), et effectuer les étapes de fabrication de composants, développées dans le cadre des formations dispensées. Elle sera également en charge du développement de nouveaux procédés. Dans le cadre de ces missions, la ou le titulaire du poste devra utiliser des produits chimiques, et donc en gérer les aspects sécurité. Elle devra utiliser des équipements de caractérisation (ex : microscopie, ellipsométrie, profilométrie) dans le cadre des formations dispensées, et devra pouvoir former des utilisateurs à ces techniques.
Recherche
Etant associé aux départements de recherche du CMP, notamment le département d’électronique flexible, des activités complémentaires de recherche sont envisageables.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons
Les candidates et candidats doivent être titulaires au minimum d’un bac+5, et avoir une expérience dans la microélectronique, en process et caractérisation en salle blanche.
Une forte polyvalence est requise pour ce poste, avec notamment des compétences en :

• Procédés (connaissance et maîtrise) : photolithographie, gravure humide et sèche, dépôts de couches minces et traitements thermiques,

• Caractérisation physique de matériaux et dispositifs, et caractérisation électrique de dispositifs.

Une expérience dans le domaine de la formation technique est un réel atout.

Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Muttersprachenniveau) und exzellente Englischkenntnisse.

title: Staff Engineer (AI Native)
description:
Buscamos a pessoa que será referência técnica em engenharia de software AI-native na Bemobi : quem define como os times especificam, delegam a agentes de IA e verificam o que é entregue, sem abrir mão dos fundamentos de arquitetura, qualidade e segurança.
Essa posição responde pelos padrões de desenvolvimento assistido por agentes - specs, contexto, guardrails, verificação e harness compartilhado - e pela confiabilidade do que vai para produção. Atua em desenvolvimento e operação, e mede sucesso por resultado para o negócio e para o usuário, não por volume de código gerado.
#BeABemober 💙🚀

• Especificação e contexto: definir o padrão de specs verificáveis - pré e pós-condições, invariantes, Given/When/Then - e manter o contexto que os agentes usam (, , skills e restrições).

• Decomposição e orquestração: quebrar problemas complexos em unidades que um agente executa e um humano consegue verificar, coordenando vários agentes, worktrees isoladas e passagens de bastão.

• Política de delegação: definir com os times o que se delega à IA (o que é fácil de verificar, de baixo risco ou repetitivo) e o que fica com as pessoas (design, decisões de produto e contexto organizacional).

• Verificação: estabelecer a estratégia de testes, evals, mutation testing e benchmarks, e levar a revisão de código para o foco em intenção e risco, que escala com o volume gerado por agentes.

• Guardrails determinísticos: garantir CI rigoroso, proteção de branch, CODEOWNERS, lotes pequenos e rollback fácil como base de confiança no sistema.

• Segurança desde o início: desenhar agentes com identidade própria, menor privilégio, sandbox e defesa em profundidade, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação.

• Harness como produto: evoluir o setup compartilhado de engenharia - instruções, ferramentas, hooks e skills - incorporando o que se aprende com cada falha.

• Operação e confiabilidade: definir níveis de autonomia dos agentes em produção (L0 a L3), com autorização progressiva, dry-run e mecanismo de parada imediata; tratar cada agente como serviço, com SLOs, observabilidade e plano de contingência.

• IA na operação: aplicar IA onde ela agrega - playbooks, detecção de anomalia, RCA, rascunho de postmortem e handoff de incidente - sem substituir automação clássica que já resolve.

• Formação do time: mentorar ativamente, em especial juniores e plenos, e manter trilhas de fundamentos com prática deliberada sem IA, combatendo a atrofia de habilidades.

• Comunicação com o negócio: traduzir limites, riscos e ganhos da IA para liderança e áreas de negócio, sustentando decisões técnicas com dados.

• Experiência sólida em engenharia de software, com atuação como referência técnica (Staff, Principal ou Tech Lead) em sistemas de produção de alta escala.

• Fundamentos fortes: arquitetura, estruturas de dados, invariantes e fronteiras de segurança - a base para identificar código gerado "quase certo".

• Uso intensivo e comprovado de agentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento, com domínio de context engineering e spec-driven development.

• Prática em TDD, testes automatizados e evals, e capacidade de desenhar estratégias de verificação para código gerado por IA.

• Vivência com CI/CD, controle de versão, proteção de branch e entrega em lotes pequenos.

• Vivência em operação de sistemas: observabilidade, SLOs, resposta a incidentes e postmortems.

• Segurança aplicada: menor privilégio, isolamento e gestão de identidades e segredos.

• Julgamento e desconfiança calibrada: saber quando parar e conferir, sem rejeitar a IA nem confiar cegamente nela.

• Pensamento sistêmico e de risco, com foco em resultado para o negócio e para o usuário.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, liderança e negócio, e disposição real para mentorar.

Da wir weiter wachsen, suchen wir einen dynamischen Customer Success Manager (CSM) für unser Team. Du bist cyber-affine, vertriebsorientiert und hast richtig Lust darauf, unseren Kunden weiterzuhelfen? Dann wollen wir dich unbedingt kennenlernen!
In dieser Rolle dreht sich alles darum, unseren Kunden das beste Onboarding für unsere Cyber-Tools über unsere App Stoïk Protect zu bieten. Als Teil unseres Customer Success Teams baust du starke Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden im deutschen und österreichischen Markt auf.
Außerdem sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Produkt-Feedback-Loop und koordinierst den erfolgreichen Launch neuer Features.
Deine Aufgaben
Customer Onboarding & Success

• Onboarding : Du übernimmst den Onboarding-Prozess für neue Kunden und sorgst für ein nahtloses Erlebnis - je nach Kundengröße im Webinar-Format oder als 1:1-Session. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben im Onboarding-Alltag gehst du dabei mit einer positiven Einstellung an.

• Basic Support: Du bearbeitest Anfragen rund um die Implementierung von Stoïk Protect über unser Ticketing-System. Du meisterst ein hohes Volumen an Kundenkontakten, hältst unsere SLAs zuverlässig ein und sicherst so eine Top-Kundenzufriedenheit.

• Advanced Support: Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Team leistest du fortgeschrittenen Support zu Cyber-Tools und versicherungstechnischen Voraussetzungen, um das Sicherheitsniveau unserer Kunden spürbar zu erhöhen.

Sales Promotion

• Kunden halten: Du trägst direkt zur Retention-Rate bei Stoïk bei, indem du das Cyber-Präventionsversprechen einlöst, das unser Sales-Team gegeben hat.

• Makler überzeugen: Du schärfst bei Versicherungsmaklern das Bewusstsein dafür, wie wichtig Stoïk Protect für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden ist.

• Cross-Selling erkennen: In den Onboarding-Sessions erkennst du Chancen für unsere Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services und koordinierst das Follow-up eng mit den Cyber- und Sales-Teams.

Projektmanagement

• Prozesse skalieren: Du hilfst dabei, den Onboarding-Prozess stetig zu verbessern, um die Implementierungsrate unserer Cyber-Tools zu steigern. Dem Product-Team lieferst du wertvolles Feedback und konkrete Empfehlungen.

• Content erstellen: Du erstellst Leitfäden, Dokumente und Schulungsmaterialien, die das Onboarding einfacher und schneller machen.

• Schnittstellen nutzen: Du durchdringst unsere Unternehmensstruktur und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams (Cyber, Tech, Product, Marketing) zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und effizient zu lösen.

Das bringst du mit

• Cybersecurity-Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Bereich Cybersicherheit ist bei uns ein absolutes Must-have.

• Kommunikationstalent: Stark in Kommunikation und Präsentation, empathisch im Umgang mit Menschen und erfahren in der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams.

• Umsetzungsstärke: Prozessorientierte Denkweise mit einer klaren "Hands-on"-Mentalität - du lernst schnell und bringst Dinge einfach über die Ziellinie.

• Vertriebs-Gespür: Eine leichte Vertriebsorientierung und das Händchen dafür, Zusatzleistungen überzeugend einzubringen.

• Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

title: Frontend Engineer - Internship
description:
Certa http://certa.ai/ is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

This is a paid 6-month internship with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at the end based on performance. You'll build the interfaces enterprise users interact with every day, shipping real features to real customers from your first sprint, with real ownership and direct mentorship from senior engineers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build UI components: Develop pixel-perfect, highly interactive UI components in React.

- Turn designs into code: Translate Figma designs into production-ready code, and push back when the design doesn't make sense.

- Own performance: Care about load times, re-renders, and bundle sizes.

- Collaborate on APIs: Work with backend engineers to define APIs and data contracts.

- Ship end-to-end with quality: Write component tests, maintain a high standard for code quality, and ship features end-to-end, not just the "frontend part."

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- JS/TS fundamentals: A solid grasp of JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals: closures, async, and the event loop.

- React: Working knowledge of React: hooks, state management, and component lifecycle.

- Real project experience: You've shipped something real to the web (even if small) and gone beyond tutorials: thoughtful state management (what lives where and why), API integration with loading/error/auth handling, forms with client- and server-aware validation, multi-page routing (nested and protected routes, query params), or working with a component library or design system.

- Debugging & performance: You can look at a broken UI and fix it without being told where to start, and you've used browser DevTools to spot and fix a slow render.

- Quality & UX: You care about accessibility, responsiveness, and edge cases, not just happy paths, and you have opinions about UX that you're not afraid to voice.

- AI-assisted building: You use AI tools (Copilot, v0, or similar) to build faster, and know when a suggestion is right and when it's subtly wrong.

INTERNSHIP DETAILS & WHAT YOU GET

- Duration: A paid 6-month internship, with the opportunity to transition to a full-time role at the end based on performance.

- Compensation: Competitive compensation, benchmarked above market for fresher roles.

- The work: Complex, high-stakes enterprise UIs - enterprise software done right - with your code shipping to real customers quickly.

- Mentorship & impact: Direct mentorship from senior engineers who push you to grow fast, and real ownership from day one.

LOCATION

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

- London

- San Francisco

- Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

WHY CERTA

- Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

- Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

- A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.
At bunny.net , we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

• Experience leading technical pre-sales and building smarter ways to scale it

• A track record of managing technical people and helping them grow

• A habit of spotting what's slowing things down and finding a better way

• The curiosity to learn fast and the confidence to make things happen without waiting for instructions

• A knack for making complex ideas simple, whether you’re talking to developers or business leaders

What will make us extra happy?

• You've helped take Solutions Engineering to the next level at a growing cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS company

• You've helped partners turn technical know-how into real customer wins

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences is the world's leading marketplace for tours, activities, and experiences. Our mission is to bring more wonder to the world by delivering exceptional experiences to travelers wherever they are. We offer an unparalleled opportunity to be part of the future of the travel experiences industry.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, Experiences, the Senior Director of Destination Management leads Viator's global destination management team. You will bring a deep understanding of the global operator community and use it to develop strategies that solve business problems and support our mutual goal with operators: delivering exceptional experiences to travelers. 

This is an operational role. You will be expected to deliver significant business outcomes by leading and motivating a global team, with decisive leadership and a strong bias for action.

•

•
Build and retain top talent, and maintain a leadership bench and succession plan for Regional Manager roles.

Connectivity

Innovation and AI

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

To make Affirm the best way to pay, the Consumer Payments team works to ensure that any customer can successfully utilize their financial data and preferred payment method to transact, without harming their financial health. The systems owned by the Consumer Payments team move billions of dollars per year, this means reliability and scalability are at the heart of everything we do.

What You'll Do

• You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

• You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

title: Senior Tumor Registrar- Remote
description:
Baystate Health is seeking an experienced Senior Tumor Registrar to join the Baystate Regional Cancer Program in Springfield, MA.

Responsibilities:
The Senior Tumor Registrar plays an important part in maintaining the accuracy and integrity of cancer registry data used to support patient outcomes, clinical research, quality improvement, and regulatory reporting. You’ll review and analyze medical records, prepare and maintain comprehensive cancer abstracts, coordinate special studies, and ensure compliance with Massachusetts state requirements and American College of Surgeons standards.

The Senior Tumor Registrar also serves as a knowledgeable resource to investigators, physicians, and colleagues while helping support the daily operations and development of the cancer registry team.

•
Maintain Accurate Cancer Registry Data: Review medical records and abstract cancer-related information with a high level of accuracy and completeness.

•
Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Maintain reporting to the Massachusetts State Cancer Registry in accordance with established procedures, state regulations, and American College of Surgeons standards.

•
Support Research & Quality Improvement: Conduct audits, special studies, and data analysis to support clinical research, patient outcomes, and Cancer Committee initiatives.

•
Monitor Patient Follow-Up: Gather and update survival information for patients diagnosed and treated with cancer at Baystate Medical Center.

•
Coordinate Special Projects: Support data collection, research study coordination, outcome measurements, and performance improvement indicators.

•
Support Program Accreditation: Maintain the electronic Survey Application Record (SAR) required for American College of Surgeons certification.

•
Provide Team Leadership: Assist with training and supervising tumor registry staff, assigning work, and monitoring performance.

•
Serve as a Resource: Work with investigators, research coordinators, physicians, and other staff to support cancer registry activities and access to program services.

•
Manage Multiple Priorities: Coordinate detailed projects while maintaining accuracy, meeting deadlines, and following established policies and procedures

Location:

•
Fully remote work opportunity in the following approved states : CT, FL, MD, NH, NC, OH, RI, SC, TN, TX, VT, & VA

Schedule:

• Full-time, 40 hours a week

• Flexible work schedule

Qualifications:

• Associates degree, required

• Current Certified Tumor Registrar (CTR) certification through the National Cancer Registrars Association (NCRA). Certification must remain current throughout employment.

• At least 1 year of successful supervisory experience

• COC Accreditation experience, strongly preferred

• Demonstrated accuracy and exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong understanding of data collection and research principles.

• Knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and physiology.

• Familiarity with federal and state research regulations.

• Strong computer skills, including medical databases, web-based applications, Microsoft Word, and Excel.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and time management skills.

• Ability to communicate, implement, and reinforce policies and procedures with team members.

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision while collaborating effectively with physicians and multidisciplinary teams.
